Lets not make this a shared ptr without knowing the actual root cause.

i2cInterface is a var in ISL69269 class and its lifetime is tied to the lifetime of ISL69269 instance.

What does it say after dropping this-> ?

> What does it say after dropping this-> ?

I am wondering if it would make a difference. ```getProgStatus``` calls ```dmaReadWrite``` which does access ```i2cInterface``` member variable.

So there is access to the instance (via this) or otherwise.

May the ```co_await``` suspend the coroutine in case there is another coroutine pending to be run? In that case the clang-tidy has no way to know if the lifetime of the ISL69269 instance has already ended at the point the coroutine actually starts.

Let me know if you think that's a plausible issue with the code. I'm not too familiar with the stdexec/sdbusplus coroutine implementation there.

> Lets not make this a shared ptr without knowing the actual root cause.

I am 80% sure clang-tidy knows the issue but it's just bad at communicating it. A lifetime issue can always manifest as an uninitialized branch.
